title: signal_quality artifact (v1)
description: Versioned cross-repo contract for s3://{research-bucket}/backtest/{run_date}/signal_quality.json (config-I7599). Written by crucible-backtester reporter.py::save from analysis/signal_quality.py::compute_accuracy's return value, verbatim — an ALWAYS-EMIT artifact (written on every run, including non-'ok' status) so its absence unambiguously means the producer never ran, per the same convention as the other structured analysis files reporter.save writes. First-class replacement for reconstructing this data by excluding a fixed key set from metrics.json (crucible-evaluator grading/artifacts.py::_read_signal_quality / _METRICS_NON_OVERALL_KEYS), which structurally cannot carry `by_score_bucket` since metrics.json only ever receives the flattened `overall` block. The metrics.json reconstruction remains as an explicitly-labelled fallback for historical dates that predate this artifact. Additive-only evolution: new optional top-level or `overall`/`by_score_bucket` fields may be added freely; renaming or removing an existing field, or changing a field's type, requires a `schema` version bump coordinated with the crucible-evaluator consumer (grading/artifacts.py::_read_signal_quality).

status.description: 'ok' iff `overall` and `by_score_bucket` are populated and trustworthy. 'insufficient_data' when analysis/signal_quality.py::compute_accuracy had fewer than MIN_SAMPLES rows with the canonical 21d outcome populated — `overall`/`by_score_bucket` are absent in that case. Any other value (e.g. 'skipped', 'error', 'db_not_found') means the consumer must treat this artifact as unavailable, matching how metrics.json's own `status` key is already read.

overall.description: Portfolio-wide slice metrics — the same block metrics.json flattens to its own top level (accuracy_5d/21d, avg_alpha_5d/21d, n_5d/21d, ci_95_5d/21d, precision_21d, tp_21d, fp_21d, ...). Present only when status == 'ok'.

by_score_bucket.description: Accuracy split into score buckets ([60-70, 70-80, 80-90, 90+] per analysis/signal_quality.py::_accuracy_by_score_bucket). Present only when status == 'ok'. This is the field metrics.json's reconstruction-by-exclusion could never carry — the whole reason this artifact exists.

by_conviction.description: Optional accuracy split by conviction (rising/stable/declining), present only when the source df carries a `conviction` column.
